description: This file defines the ElasticTranscoderClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used for interacting with the Amazon Elastic Transcoder service. It primarily provides method signatures for various AWS API actions related to transcoding jobs, pipelines, and presets.

classes.name: ElasticTranscoderClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Elastic Transcoder service, extending the base AwsClient class. It exposes methods for managing jobs, pipelines, and presets asynchronously and synchronously.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Method to cancel a transcoding job.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Method to create a new transcoding job.

methods.name: createPipeline
methods.description: Method to create a new transcoding pipeline.

methods.name: createPreset
methods.description: Method to create a new preset.

methods.name: deletePipeline
methods.description: Method to delete an existing pipeline.

methods.name: listJobsByPipeline
methods.description: Retrieve list of jobs for a specific pipeline.

methods.name: listJobsByStatus
methods.description: Retrieve list of jobs by status.

methods.name: readJob
methods.description: Get details of a specific job.

methods.name: readPipeline
methods.description: Get details of a specific pipeline.

methods.name: testRole
methods.description: Test the IAM role associated with the client.

methods.name: updatePipelineNotifications
methods.description: Update the notifications for a pipeline.

methods.name: updatePipelineStatus
methods.description: Update the status of a pipeline.
